releases.description: - fix: make reseam settings icon follow theme

- feat(youtube): save experiment flags to Downloads by long-pressing Reseam Settings in YouTube and YouTube Music
- fix(youtube): request the original audio language only from clients that return one track
- fix(youtube): keep the navigation bar visible when the feed also hides its container
- feat(instagram): add a Reseam Settings button to the profile, older posts after the following feed and Hide suggested Reels
- fix(tiktok): hide the ads inserted between a profile's videos
- fix(reddit): keep reporting post views so Home stops repeating posts, with a Block post views toggle
- fix(reddit): hide the comment ads the post detail ad loader places
- fix: look up app resources under the package they were built with, so renamed apps find them
- feat: add the native Android playback client, choosing each client's token automatically

- fix(youtube): bind server PoTokens to the caller's content binding
- chore: move donations page to /donate
- ci: use the node24 releases of the checkout, cache and setup actions

- build: require engine 0.28.0
- ci: build and release in the shared CI image through just

- fix: keep hook registrations to one run, so a patch the engine undoes does not register its hooks twice
- build: require engine 0.27.0

- build: require engine 0.26.3
- feat(youtube): show the Cast button by default and add Restore Cast Play/Queue dialog
- feat: use Reseam GmsCore by default, with Cast and only its media route providers

- fix(tiktok): show the Reseam settings gear on the signed-in profile
- feat(tiktok): add Fix login, which makes logging in with Google and Facebook work
- feat(tiktok): add TikTok patches
- fix(youtube): stop Scrubbing preview crashing the app when a video changes

- build: require engine 0.26.0
- feat(youtube): add Search inside channels and Live rings open the channel
- feat(youtube): add Play Shorts as regular videos and Turn off Shorts, which covers every Shorts hiding setting
- fix(youtube): open YouTube links in the patched app when another YouTube is installed
- fix: ship the GmsCore texts so its startup warnings show instead of crashing YouTube and YouTube Music

- build: require engine 0.25.0
- feat(youtube): add Material You to Theme and color the surfaces current YouTube uses
- feat(youtube): add Keep navigation bar visible, which stops the bottom bar hiding on scroll
- fix(youtube): hide the floating microphone on the search screens
- feat: support YouTube 21.40.166, X 12.34.0, Instagram 451.0.0.53.80 and Reddit 2026.41.0
- feat: list Reseam Settings first in every app's settings
- chore: add funding links

- build: require engine 0.24.0
- feat(discord): write extensions in TypeScript with before and after hooks and Discord module imports, and add Add source cards
- fix: adjust default patches and in-app settings for launch

- build: require engine 0.23.0
- refactor: port all extensions to Kotlin with @Export bindings, settings modules and string tables, and drop the ReVanced header from files that no longer hold its code
- feat(discord): add Custom themes, which creates, edits, previews and shares full themes, with a Reseam theme

- feat(telegram): choose which chats Recover deleted messages covers from the chat menu
- fix(telegram): show recovered messages only inside the range Telegram loaded, so a deleted latest message shows again

- fix(telegram): make Recover deleted messages opt-in
- fix(telegram): show recovered messages only inside the loaded page, so newer messages stop disappearing
- docs(discord): describe how extensions reach Discord's modules
- feat(discord): add Server details to a server's options: owner, creation date, members, boosts and more
- feat(discord): add Draft preview, which shows a message only you see when you long press send
- feat(discord): add Jump to first message, a button above Jump to present
- feat(discord): add Colored names, which colors members in mentions, typing, voice and member list headers
- feat(discord): add Moderator badges, which tag the owner, admins, managers and moderators in chat
- feat(discord): add Better stream quality, which streams at the qualities Nitro unlocks
- build: require engine 0.22.0

- fix(youtube): hide product stickers in Shorts
- feat(youtube): hide the toolbar messages button
- refactor(youtube): rename the Downloads patch to External downloader
- fix(youtube): answer refused downloads with spoofing off, so they work on mounted installs
- feat: brand every app's settings screen as Reseam on the engine's app runtime, with icons
- fix(youtube): make Unlock queue work on the first launch
